def: An East Indian plant (Kæmpferia Galanga) of the Ginger family.See Galanga.
A period of seven days, usually that reckoned from one Sabbathor Sunday to the next.I fast twice in the week. Luke xviii. 12.
A small wagon used for the underground work of a mine.Tomlison.
The doctrine or science of generation.

The hinder part or buttocks of certain quadrupeds, especiallyof a horse; hence, the place behind the saddle.So light to the croup the fair lady he swung, So light to the saddlebefore her he sprung. Sir W. Scott.
The framework or skeleton upon which a regiment is to beformed; the officers of a regiment forming the staff. [Written alsocader.]
A doubling together or folding; a duplication. [R.]
